quests.desc: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. Your first objective is to retrieve the TextWorld limited edition keycard from the desk. After taking the TextWorld limited edition keycard, make an attempt to take a trip north. And then, check that the TextWorld limited edition gateway within the cellar is unlocked with the TextWorld limited edition keycard. Then, make absolutely sure that the TextWorld limited edition gateway is opened. After that, head north. After that, move west. After that, try to venture south. Once you get around to doing that, attempt to move west. After that, go north. If you can get around to doing that, take the passkey from the bureau within the study. After taking the passkey, make an attempt to go west. Once you get around to doing that, unlock the hatch with the passkey. Then, open the hatch. Then, attempt to head west. Once you succeed at that, go south. Okay, and then, retrieve the fly larva from the floor of the studio. That's it!

objective: I hope you're ready to go into rooms and interact with objects, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is how to play! First of all, take the TextWorld limited edition keycard from the desk. And then, take a trip north. That done, unlock the TextWorld limited edition gateway with the TextWorld limited edition keycard. And then, open the TextWorld limited edition gateway in the cellar. And then, venture north. And then, make an attempt to move west. Then, travel south. Then, try to travel west. Okay, and then, venture north. Then, pick up the passkey from the bureau within the study. After that, go to the west. Then, unlock the hatch within the cookhouse. Once you have unlocked the hatch, ensure that the hatch is open. After that, try to go west. That done, make an effort to travel south. With that accomplished, pick-up the fly larva from the floor of the studio. Got that? Good!
